dialogue.content: こんにちは。時間になりましたら始めさせて頂きます。今日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello. We'll get started now that it's our scheduled time. I look forward to speaking with you today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ宜しくお願いいたしますm(_ _)m
dialogue.English: Thank you, I look forward to it as well.

dialogue.content: はじめまして。カウンセラーのはなまると申します。はじめに、ご年齢と性別を教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: It's nice to meet you. My name is Hanamaru and I'll be your counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: はじめまして39歳女性です
dialogue.English: It's nice to meet you. I'm a 39-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。それでは、今日のご相談内容を教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. Now, could you please tell me what you'd like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 子供のことです今月高3になる予定だったのですが、一年ほど前から朝起きれなくなり遅刻と欠席ばかりで留年してしまいました
dialogue.English: It's about my child. She was supposed to become a senior in high school this month, but for about a year now, she hasn't been able to wake up in the morning. With so many late arrivals and absences, she had to repeat the year.

dialogue.content: 昨年の終わり頃からほとんど登校もしていなくて、留年はしたけどもちろん登校しないですし通信への転校も考えているのですが本人何もやる気がなさそうでどうしたらいいのかわかりません
dialogue.English: She's barely been going to school at all since the end of last year. Even though she has to repeat the grade, she's of course still not attending. We're considering transferring her to a correspondence school, but she seems to have no motivation for anything, and I don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お母さんとしては、それはすごくご心配ですね。お子様が何かつらくなるような理由が何かあったのでしょうか。
dialogue.English: I see. As her mother, that must be very worrisome. Do you know if anything happened that might be making things hard for her?

dialogue.content: それが学校には友達もいて、登校しなくても仲良くしてて、遊びに行ったりはするし、バイトも行きます。先生に聞いたらいじめ問題もなさそうなんです。ただのなまけぐせです
dialogue.English: That's the thing, she has friends at school and gets along with them even when she doesn't go. She goes out with them and also goes to her part-time job. I asked her teacher, and it doesn't seem to be a bullying issue. It's just laziness.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。学校に行けなくなった理由がはっきりしないのは、悩んでしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It must be troubling when the reason she stopped going to school isn't clear.

dialogue.content: そうですねお金のことしか考えていないんです友達と高価なプレゼント交換したりお化粧したりするためにバイトは行くのに学校には行けないなんて
dialogue.English: Yes. All she thinks about is money. She’ll go to her part-time job to exchange expensive gifts with friends and to buy makeup, but she can’t seem to go to school.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お子様にはお子様の想いもあるでしょうが、お母さんからしたら本当に心配だと思います。
dialogue.English: I understand. Your daughter may have her own feelings about it, but from a mother's perspective, I can imagine it's truly worrisome.

dialogue.content: 学校からも通信への転校を勧められて検討してるんですけど、通信にしたからってやれるのかなって思って
dialogue.English: The school has also recommended transferring to a correspondence program, and we’re considering it, but I wonder whether she’d actually be able to do it even if we switched.

dialogue.content: どう言えばやる気を出してくれるんでしょうか
dialogue.English: What can I say to get her motivated?

dialogue.content: 通信への勧めが学校からあったのですね。お子様はこもれびさんに学校に行きたくない理由をお話になることはありますか？
dialogue.English: So the school has suggested a correspondence program. Does your daughter ever tell you, Komorebi, why she doesn't want to go to school?

dialogue.content: ないですもうどうでもいいって
dialogue.English: No, she just says "whatever" or "I don't care."

dialogue.content: そのようにおっしゃるんですね。お子様にどう声をかけてあげれば迷ってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I see—that’s what she says. It must leave you unsure how to talk to her.

dialogue.content: もう何言ってもダメです何も考えてない大学には行って欲しかったけど、今はもうなんでもいいから、ちゃんと働くなりなんなり、考えてちゃんとして欲しい
dialogue.English: Nothing I say gets through anymore. She isn’t thinking about anything. I wanted her to go to university, but now I just want her to do anything—work or whatever—as long as she thinks things through and gets herself together.

dialogue.content: 親からすれば、これは本当に大きな悩みですよね。おつらいだろうなと思います。通信のお話はお子様にすでにされているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: From a parent's perspective, this is a truly significant worry. I can imagine how painful it must be. Have you already spoken to your daughter about the correspondence school option?

dialogue.content: 3〜4ヶ月前からしています留年かもしれないと言われてから、、、
dialogue.English: I have, for the past three to four months... ever since we were told she might have to repeat the year.

dialogue.content: 通信のお話をしてみて、お子様の反応はいかがでした？
dialogue.English: And when you talked to her about the correspondence school, how did she react?

dialogue.content: 何でもいいどうでもいいと
dialogue.English: She just said, "Whatever, I don't care."

dialogue.content: そのようにお返事されたのですね。それでは困ってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: That was her response. That must leave you at a loss.

dialogue.content: はい優しく言っても叱っても何も響きません
dialogue.English: Yes. Whether I speak to her gently or scold her, nothing gets through to her.

dialogue.content: 周りからは反抗期だから仕方ないって言われるけど、反抗期の子もみんなちゃんと学校には行ってるし受験もするじゃないですか
dialogue.English: People around me say it’s just a rebellious phase and it can’t be helped, but even kids in a rebellious phase still go to school and take entrance exams, don’t they?

dialogue.content: そうでよね。こもれびさんにパートナーの方がいらっしゃれば、その方はどのようにお考えでしょうか？
dialogue.English: That's true. If you have a partner, Komorebi, what are their thoughts on the situation?

dialogue.content: 父親はもう諦めてますもうダメだ〜、って笑ってます
dialogue.English: Her father has already given up. He just laughs and says, "She's a lost cause."

dialogue.content: 父親とすごく似てるんです頑固で融通がきかなくて
dialogue.English: She’s very similar to her father—stubborn and inflexible.

dialogue.content: ご主人はそのようにおっしゃるんですね。ご主人と性格が似てるんですね。
dialogue.English: So that's what your husband says. And she has a similar personality to him.

dialogue.content: そうです父親への反発じゃないかと思うんですけど、だからってどうすればいいのか
dialogue.English: Yes. I think it might be a rebellion against her father, but even so, I don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: 父親への反発とお考えになられる理由は何かおありでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is there any particular reason you think it's a rebellion against her father?

dialogue.content: 厳しいし、口うるさいしコロナでリモート勤務になって家にいるようになってからは特にあれこれ口出しするし一度、わたしが夫と大喧嘩して離婚を考えたことがあったんですけど、「なんであのとき離婚しなかったの」って言われました
dialogue.English: He’s strict and nagging, and since COVID when he started working remotely and being at home, he’s been meddling even more. Once, I had a big fight with my husband and even considered divorce, and my daughter said to me, “Why didn’t you divorce him back then?”

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。なぜ離婚しなかったのかと言われたのは、お子様は離婚して欲しかったからそうおっしゃったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. When she asked why you didn't get a divorce, do you think it was because she wanted you to?

dialogue.content: はい、離婚すれば良かったのにって
dialogue.English: Yes, she said we should have divorced.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。こもれびさんは、お子様が学校に行かなくなった理由をご主人への反発と言われましたが、そうお考えになる理由はありますか？
dialogue.English: I see. You mentioned that you think the reason your daughter stopped going to school is her rebellion against your husband. Are there any other reasons you think that?

dialogue.content: わたしもですけど、大学には行くようにずっと言ってきて、そのために高校受験も少し難しい学校を頑張って受験して
dialogue.English: Both he and I have been telling her all along to go to university, and for that, she worked hard to take the entrance exam for a slightly more challenging high school.

dialogue.content: 合格して順調だったけど父親が嫌いで反抗したいんじゃないでしょうか
dialogue.English: She got in and things were going smoothly, but maybe she dislikes her father and wants to rebel.

dialogue.content: 父親の言う通りにしたくないのかも
dialogue.English: Maybe she doesn't want to do what her father says.

dialogue.content: こもれびさんはそのようにお考えなんですね。もしかするとお子様はプレッシャーをお感じになっていたのかなと思うのですが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: That’s how you see it. I wonder if your daughter might have been feeling pressure—what do you think?

dialogue.content: そうなんでしょうか、、勉強できる子なんです。順調だったのに
dialogue.English: Could that be it? She's a good student. Everything was going so well.

dialogue.content: 勉強を頑張られるお子様だったのですね。お子様が本当はどうなりたいかをもう少し詳しく聞ければないいのかなと思いますね。
dialogue.English: So she was a child who worked hard at her studies. I think it might be good if we could learn a little more about what your daughter truly wants for herself.

dialogue.content: 学校の先生には美容系に進みたいって言ってたらしくてだから専門学校とかもいいんじゃないって話したけどとりあえず高校卒業はして欲しいから
dialogue.English: Apparently, she told her teacher she wants to go into the beauty industry. So I told her that a vocational school might be a good idea, but I at least want her to graduate from high school first.

dialogue.content: でも、そんな話をしてもどうでもいいって感じで、本気で考えないんですだから美容系っていうのも本気なのか専門学校に行ってもやれるのか疑問です
dialogue.English: But even when I talk about that, she acts like she doesn't care and won't think about it seriously. So I doubt whether she's truly serious about the beauty industry or if she'd even stick with it if she went to a vocational school.

dialogue.content: お子様はそういう想いがあるのですね。美容系の専門学校の話をした時のお子様の反応はいかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: So your daughter does have that interest. How did she react when you talked about a beauty vocational school?

dialogue.content: 専門学校に行きたい想いがあるとお子様はおっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.English: So, your daughter does say she has an interest in attending a vocational school?

dialogue.content: そうですね、とりあえず高校卒業の資格をとったら、、、
dialogue.English: Yes, well, once she at least gets her high school diploma…

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お子様には美容系の専門学校に行くには、高校卒業の資格をとった方がいいことをお伝えしてみては？
dialogue.English: I see. Have you tried explaining to your daughter that to go to a beauty vocational school, it would be best to have a high school diploma?

dialogue.content: 言ってます
dialogue.English: I've told her that.

dialogue.content: それを言ってもやる気にならなくて困ってます
dialogue.English: Even when I say that, she still isn’t motivated, and I don’t know what to do.

dialogue.content: そろそろお時間になるのですが、良い答えが出せずにすみません。お話してみていかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: We're running out of time, and I'm sorry I couldn't provide a clear answer for you. How was it for you to talk about this today?

dialogue.content: どうしたら娘のやる気を出させることができるのか聞きたかったのですが、、、でも、父親に反抗しているんだなとかはわかってきました
dialogue.English: I wanted to know how to motivate my daughter... but I've come to understand that she might be rebelling against her father.

dialogue.content: 父親を少し娘と離してみたいと思います
dialogue.English: I think I will try to put a bit of distance between her and her father.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。こもれびさんの娘様への愛情をすごく感じます。大切に育ててこられたのだろうなと。
dialogue.English: I see. I can really feel the love you have for your daughter. It's clear that you've raised her with great care.

dialogue.content: 配布
dialogue.English: Distribution

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます😭😭
dialogue.English: Thank you so much.

dialogue.content: 今日はご相談頂き、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for consulting with me today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: お疲れ様でした。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time.

dialogue.content: お疲れ様でした！とても勉強になりました！ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time! This was very helpful! Thank you very much!

dialogue.content: それではこれで終わりにさせて頂きます。こちらこそ勉強させて頂きました。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Then we'll conclude our session here. I also learned a lot from this. Thank you.
